title: Asyncio patterns
text: Asyncio lets one event loop coordinate many I/O-bound tasks. Coroutines yield at await points while sockets wait for data.

title: FastAPI search service
text: FastAPI exposes an HTTP API with validation, dependency injection, lifespan startup and typed response models.

title: Pydantic validation
text: Pydantic validates request data at the application boundary and serializes structured response models.

title: Concurrency and GIL
text: CPU-bound Python work is affected by the GIL. Threads can help when work blocks, while processes can use multiple CPU cores.

title: Docker deployment
text: Docker packages the service with a reproducible environment. A non-root process improves container isolation.

title: Search ranking
text: BM25 and TF-IDF rank documents by matching query terms against the inverted index.

title: HTTP request path
text: An ASGI server accepts a socket connection, builds a request scope, calls the application and sends the response back to the client.

title: Web interface
text: The search page shows snippets, highlighted matches, scores, pagination and links to complete documents.
